subject: geography
title: Changing Economic World: Nigeria Case Study

concepts.def: West African NEE; largest population in Africa over 220 million.
Crude oil contributes around 90% of export earnings.
Manufacturing share of GDP has risen with film, food and cement.
Major TNC operating in the Niger Delta since the 1950s.
Nigeria's film industry, one of the world's largest by output.
Nigeria receives aid but trade dominates its development. 🛢

walkthroughs.body_html:
Nigeria is the regional powerhouse of West Africa.

Population over 220 million and oil-rich Niger Delta.

It is classed as a Newly Emerging Economy.

The economy is shifting.

Primary share is falling as manufacturing and services grow.

Cement giant Dangote and Nollywood show the new economy.

Shell is a key TNC.

It brings jobs, taxes and infrastructure but is blamed for oil spills in the Niger Delta.

This shows the trade-offs of TNC investment.
